segments.an3.123:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kusinārāyaṃ viharati baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe.
segments.an3.123:2.1: “Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati.
segments.an3.123:2.2: Tamenaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upasaṅkamitvā svātanāya bhattena nimanteti.
segments.an3.123:2.4: So tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamati; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdati.
segments.an3.123:2.5: Tamenaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāreti.
segments.an3.123:3.2: ‘sādhu vata myāyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāretī’ti.
segments.an3.123:3.4: ‘aho vata māyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā āyatimpi evarūpena paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappeyya sampavāreyyā’ti!
segments.an3.123:3.5: So taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ gathito [gadhito (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] mucchito ajjhosanno [ajjhāpanno (sī. ka.) ajjhopanno (ṭīkā)] anādīnavadassāvī anissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
segments.an3.123:3.6: So tattha kāmavitakkampi vitakketi, byāpādavitakkampi vitakketi, vihiṃsāvitakkampi vitakketi.
segments.an3.123:3.7: Evarūpassāhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno dinnaṃ na mahapphalanti vadāmi.
segments.an3.123:4.1: “Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati.
segments.an3.123:4.2: Tamenaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upasaṅkamitvā svātanāya bhattena nimanteti.
segments.an3.123:4.4: So tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamati; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdati.
segments.an3.123:4.5: Tamenaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāreti.
segments.an3.123:5.2: ‘sādhu vata myāyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāretī’ti.
segments.an3.123:5.4: ‘aho vata māyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā āyatimpi evarūpena paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappeyya sampavāreyyā’ti!
segments.an3.123:5.5: So taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ agathito amucchito anajjhosanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
segments.an3.123:5.6: So tattha nekkhammavitakkampi vitakketi, abyāpādavitakkampi vitakketi, avihiṃsāvitakkampi vitakketi.
segments.an3.123:5.7: Evarūpassāhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno dinnaṃ mahapphalanti vadāmi.

lines: Tattha kira bhūtabalikaraṇatthaṃ baliṃ haranti, tasmā baliharaṇanti vuccati.
Sampavāretīti alaṃ alanti vācāya ceva hatthavikārena ca paṭikkhipāpeti.
Sādhu vata māyanti sādhu vata maṃ ayaṃ.
Anissaraṇapaññoti chandarāgaṃ pahāya saṃkaḍḍhitvā paribhuñjanto nissaraṇapañño nāma hoti, ayaṃ na tādiso, sacchandarāgo paribhuñjatīti anissaraṇapañño.
Taṇhāya adhibhavitvā ajjhotthaṭo gilitvā pariniṭṭhapetvā viya ṭhito.

Nissaraṇapaññoti ayamattho āhāraparibhogeti tattha payojanaparicchedikā “yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā”tiādinā (ma. ni. 1.23; 2.24; 3.75; saṃ. ni. 4.120; a. ni. 6.58; 8.9) pavattā āhārapaṭibaddhachandarāganissaraṇabhūtā paññā assa atthīti nissaraṇapañño.
